scope: Closed-loop test of the registered agreement arm of the depth-aware appearance check (docs/EVAL_PROTOCOL_AGREEMENT_ARM_CLOSED_LOOP_2026-10-03.md). On an accepted frame the depth-agreement fraction replaces the NCC in the confidence, which changes the confidence gate's input; results are reported apart from D_strict + J and from every unchanged-gate run, never pooled. Control: tree0 spur 12142 with the tool-axis standoff under source light (a trellis wire crosses the camera's line of sight).
